<strong>Territoires.wiki est un site qui traite des territoires, de leurs habitants et de leurs histoires.</strong>

<p>Explorez, rencontrez, c'est à vous de jouer!</p>


<div class="wiki-card-grid noexcerpt">

    <div class="wiki-card">
        <h2 class="wiki-card-title">Actualités</h2>
        {{Components/List|
        {{#ask:
            [[Category:Articles]]
            |?description
            |?datePublished
            |limit=6
            |sort=datePublished
            |order=descending
            |format=template
            |template=Component/ListItem/Article
        }}
        }}
    </div>

    <div class="wiki-card">
        <h2 class="wiki-card-title">Événements</h2>
        {{Components/List
        {{#ask:
            [[Category:Events]]
            [[dateStart::+]]
            |?=page
            |?dateStart
            |?dateEnd
            |?place
            |?territory
            |?eventType
            |sort=dateStart
            |order=ascending
            |limit=6
            |format=template
            |template=Components/Card/Event
            |named args=yes
        }}
        }}
    </div>

    <div class="wiki-card">
        <h2 class="wiki-card-title">Territoires</h2>
        {{#dpl:
            namespace=main
            |ordermethod=created
            |order=descending
            |count=6
            |include=*
            |includemaxlength=300
            |includetrim=true
            |eliminate=categories
            |mode=userformat
            |listseparators=
            <div class="wiki-card-list">,
                <div class="wiki-list-item">
                <div class="wiki-list-item-title">[[%PAGE%|%TITLE%]]</div>
                ,
                </div>
            </div>
            |secseparators=
                <div class="wiki-list-item-excerpt">,
            </div>
        }}
    </div>

    <div class="wiki-card">
        <h2 class="wiki-card-title">Catégories</h2>
        {{#dpl:
            namespace=Category
            |mode=none
            |shownamespace=false
            |ordermethod=title
            |order=ascending
        }}
    </div>
</div>
